title: Opioid Deaths Overtook Car Crash Deaths
source: CDC/NCHS and NIDA opioid-involved overdose deaths (CDC WONDER) vs NHTSA/FARS motor vehicle traffic fatalities: opioid deaths 21,089 (2010), 33,091 (2015), 42,249 (2016), 47,600 (2017), 49,860 (2019), 80,411 (2021); motor vehicle deaths 32,999 (2010), 35,092 (2015), 37,806 (2016), 37,473 (2017), 36,096 (2019), 42,915 (2021). Opioid deaths overtook motor vehicle deaths in 2016; the National Safety Council has since reported higher odds of dying from opioid overdose than a car crash.
